fields.options:
Setting up view notifications

DocShare uses Frappe's native Notification and WhatsApp Notification framework. When a guest opens a share link, a DocShare View Log record is created (after_insert event). Configure notifications against that doctype:

  • Email: Create a Notification with Document Type = DocShare View Log, Event = New, and recipients = share_link_owner_email field.
  • WhatsApp: Create a WhatsApp Notification with Reference DocType = DocShare View Log, Doctype Event = After Insert, and phone field = share_link_owner_phone.

The View Log carries the resolved customer/lead/party name, IP address, and the share link owner's contact details so templates can reference them.
